links.detail: Liberia's Presidential Investigation Team alleged Crane conspired with CBL officials to print L$18,151,000,000, beyond the contracted L$15 billion. links.detail: Goznak (Russian state printer) printed Libyan dinars for the parallel eastern Central Bank (Benghazi/Bayda), which is not internationally recognized; Reuters-cited Russian customs data showed 4.5 billion dinars shipped Feb-June 2019. Malta seized two containers on 1 November 2019, citing UN resolutions that recognize only the Tripoli government.
links.source_title: Middle East Institute (Jonathan M. Winer): Seized Russian-printed dinars...

links.detail: The MEI article states that the regular Libyan dinar notes are printed by Britain's De La Rue.

links.detail: G+D suspended all deliveries to Myanmar's state-owned Security Print Works after the military crackdown; before that it supplied raw materials, supplies and system components for printing kyat banknotes. links.source_title: G+D press release: Giesecke+Devrient suspends deliveries to state security printer in Myanmar
